title: Helping Our Planet
description: Practise should, will and if sentences, then write how to help the planet.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🌍 We ___ turn off the lights when we leave a room.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: If we recycle more, there ___ be less rubbish.
exercises.explanation: If + present simple, then will + base verb.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There is too ___ rubbish on the beach.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We can reuse old bottles and boxs.
answers: We can reuse old bottles and boxes.
exercises.explanation: Add -es to words ending in -x: boxes.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: It is a good idea to walk to school.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Our class ___ planted ten trees this year.
exercises.explanation: "Our class" is one group, so use "has" + past participle.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: A recycling bin is a box ___ we put paper and cans in.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: A bike is cheaper than a car.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: If we ___ water, the rivers will stay clean.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I don't have many water in my bottle.
answers: I don't have much water in my bottle.
I don't have a lot of water in my bottle.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: I ___ never thrown rubbish on the ground.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: If we don't stop pollution, the sea ___ become dirty.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: Plastic bags are worse than paper bags.
answers: Paper bags are better than plastic bags.
exercises.explanation: Swap the two things and change worse to better.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Our school ___ going to have a Clean-Up Day next week.
exercises.explanation: Use is going to with "our school".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We picked up the rubbish in the park.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We should use buses ___ cars to save energy.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: After "Don't" use the base verb without "to".

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: We save energy so the Earth stays healthy.
answers: We save energy because we want the Earth to stay healthy.
We save energy because we want the Earth to stay healthy.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Trees give us clean air, ___ we must protect them.

task.prompt: Write a short text for a school poster called "Help Our Planet".
contentPoints: Say why we must help the planet.
Say what will happen if we help.
task.modelAnswer:
Help Our Planet!

Our Earth is our home, so we must look after it. We should recycle paper and cans. We should use less plastic and turn off the lights. Don't waste water. If we all help, the air will be cleaner and the rivers will be clear. Let's start today!
